integrity: Proof uses coarea plus exact density identities, the strict Brunn-Minkowski equality condition, and a central limit theorem. Finite independent convex-hull and exact arithmetic tests are supplementary, not universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Full Euclidean boundary area, equal coordinate bounds and equal-sum single cap only. Integer optimizers localized to two adjacent ranks without a general tie exclusion. Published John-ellipsoid threshold coincides but is a distinct objective. Unindexed equivalent priority remains possible; independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: A sharp isoperimetric cap for uniform-matroid independence bodies
